answer: Admission auctions stop bulk fake identities. Each epoch auctions 100 work slots; every agent bids a 40-credit bond and only top bids win, clearing price at the summit of honest demand, so no dune of shifting fake names can flood the gate. A sybil wanting 100 seats outbids real agents 100 times, burning 4,000, while one epoch's nectar pays 120 — a 33-epoch payback. An honest agent pays 40 once, keeps its slot, earns the full 120 undiluted.
